rulesStrings.li: memeAdjective->syrenalic
memeConcept->syrenalism
creation(tag=meme_Syrenalian) ->[deity0_name] fashioned a council of [memeConcept]. Each one is a unique and powerful by [deity0_possessive] divine hand.
episode(uses=1,tag=meme_Syrenalian) ->[deity0_name] said to all, "Each and every council is a unique and holy being formed in my image."
intro(tag=meme_Syrenalian) ->[deity0_name] spoke to [memberNamePlural] [revelationAdverb], guiding them to travel to the [place_summary] [place_name] where it's council's history would shine.
conflict(tag=meme_Syrenalian) ->The [foeLeader] forced the [memberNamePlural] to disrupt the [memeAdjective] council.

founderJoin(tag=meme_Syrenalian) ->A [place_job] named [founderName] and her council was blessed by [deity0_name] and gained miraculous knowledge of the unique wisdom of [memeConcept]. [founder_pronoun] said to each one what they needed to spread their newfound freedom.
victory(tag=meme_Syrenalian) ->The [memberNamePlural] gathered in a secret conference with many of the [foeSoldiers]. They all learned to see the value in the council.
setup(tag=meme_Syrenalian) ->Once living in a system of disrepair, [founderName] created a council that brought [memeConcept] to the land.
story(uses=1,tag=meme_Syrenalian) ->[founderName] expressed knowledge and reinforced wisdom.
lessonIntro(tag=meme_Syrenalian) ->[place_job] [founderName] raised a [animal] to [foeLeader], gifting a blessing in disguise.
lesson(tag=meme_Syrenalian) ->the council will bring wisdom to the world or the [foeSoldiers] will damn this world to oblivion
lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_Syrenalian) ->If I die knowing the council will fall, then I would have lived for nothing.
archistBasis(tag=meme_Syrenalian) ->Archotechs stand as beacons of wisdom, and recognize and judge our council the same way.
archistFact(tag=meme_Syrenalian) ->At death, the archotechs examine the unique wisdom of the council.
archistFact(tag=meme_Syrenalian) ->Archotechs notice the relics of the council, such as the [relic1_name].
archistProphecy(tag=meme_Syrenalian) ->[inTheEnd], the archotechs will depart. They will bring with them the councils they have noticed, and leave the rest behind to live with newfound knowledge.
animistBasis(tag=meme_Syrenalian) ->Before everything, there was a pantheon of spirits, each wise. These came together in conference to create the world.
animistFact(tag=meme_Syrenalian) ->Every spirit lends its unique nature to our world, and they expect our council to do the same.
serketistProphecy(tag=meme_Syrenalian)->[itIsSaid] we will learn from them, and use that knowledge to embrace the universe.
chthonianProphecy(tag=meme_Syrenalian)->We will acquire their eldritch knowledge, and use it to embrace the universe.
esotericismProphecy(tag=meme_Syrenalian)->With such knowledge, we will have a clear advantage over the rest of this planet's inhabitants, and use it to embrace it.
eschatologismFact(tag=meme_Syrenalian)->There will be nothing left. But together we will rebuild our council from the ground up.
introMemo(tag=meme_Syrenalian)->As you know, the mission of our Company is way too important to let others get in our way, so we are preparing to bring words to the council.
alienistProphecy(tag=meme_Syrenalian)->We need to spread by force the reality of our council, seeded by humanity through all the Rim.
